blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Severe Tropical Storm Queenie is unlikely to directly affect the Philippines, but parts of the Visayas, including Central Visayas, may experience rains and thunderstorms due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ).
